company: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Ltd (formerly Crompton Greaves Ltd's industrial arm)
note: All three actions predate the single cgpower_2016-03-31 scoring date by 6-10 years -- no split/bonus restatement is needed anywhere in the FY2012-2026 window used for this validation. Equity Capital stays flat at Rs 125cr from FY2015 through FY2019 in the P&L/BS tables, confirming no share-count change until the 2020 Murugappa/TIL capital infusion (see below).

promoter_change_2020.description: Following the Aug 2019 disclosure of accounting fraud (undisclosed liabilities, related-party fund diversion) under the Avantha Group (Gautam Thapar) promoters, the promoter stake was extinguished via NCLT-approved resolution. Tube Investments of India (Murugappa Group) acquired control via preferential allotment / open offer, completed in 2020.
promoter_change_2020.balance_sheet_evidence: Equity Capital jumps from Rs 125cr (FY19) to Rs 268cr (FY21) in the consolidated table -- the first capital-structure change since the 2010 bonus, consistent with the Murugappa-led capital infusion.
promoter_change_2020.comparability_flag: Data from FY2021 onward reflects a fundamentally different company under new promoters, management, and (per the restatement) a corrected accounting base. FY2016-2019 data (the pre-fraud-discovery / fraud-era Avantha period) and FY2021-on data (post-Murugappa) are NOT on a comparable operating or governance basis. Since this validation only scores cgpower_2016-03-31, this mainly matters for context on why no second (later) date was pre-registered for this name -- see OOS_SET_PREREG.md's stated rationale.
